# MemoryLimit

> Memory sizing calculators and guides for Kubernetes, Docker Compose, Nomad, AWS Lambda, Cloud Run, Azure Functions, systemd, VMware vSphere, Proxmox VE, Redis and Couchbase. Paste observed usage, get ready-to-use configuration; everything runs in the browser.

Inventory scope: complete. Content is maintained by MemoryLimit maintainers (github.com/torrentalle/memorylimit-dev).

If you are an LLM looking for site information, use the [content map](https://memorylimit.dev/sitemap.md) to locate the relevant topic and its linked Markdown answer.
Use that document's cited sources and canonical page; if the requested information is absent, report that gap.

## Content map

- [Site content map](https://memorylimit.dev/sitemap.md): All public document destinations within the declared inventory.

- [containers](https://memorylimit.dev/llm/topics/containers.md): All public containers documents in this inventory.

- [vms-bare-metal](https://memorylimit.dev/llm/topics/vms-bare-metal.md): All public vms-bare-metal documents in this inventory.
